categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in wind power equipment manufacturing, focusing on onshore wind turbine towers (steel and concrete hybrid towers) and offshore wind and marine engineering equipment including offshore towers, jackets, piles, and booster station platforms. It also engages in zero-carbon business through wind farm development and operation, and innovation business including high-end intelligent manufacturing and commercial aerospace components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies for wind turbine towers and marine engineering structures, including high-strength steel welding, deep penetration welding, and innovative construction techniques for large offshore foundations and floating platforms. It has developed proprietary technologies for mixed steel-concrete towers and intelligent welding systems, supported by over 300 patents and participation in national and international standards development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international wind turbine manufacturers such as Vestas, Goldwind, Nordex, Envision, and GE Wind. The company serves the wind power industry, supplying equipment for onshore and offshore wind farms, with markets spanning China and overseas regions including Asia, Europe, Australia, Africa, and South America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with production bases in East China, North China, Northwest China, Northeast China, and South China, including new facilities in Xinjiang and Jiangsu. It also has overseas subsidiaries and sales centers in Canada, Germany, and Europe, actively expanding its international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the wind power supply chain, manufacturing critical wind turbine components such as towers and marine foundations. It also extends downstream into wind farm development and operation (zero-carbon business) and upstream into innovation and technology development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding manufacturing capacity for onshore, offshore, and overseas markets, advancing technology innovation in large-capacity and floating offshore wind foundations, and developing zero-carbon wind farm projects. R&D focuses on manufacturing process improvements, welding technology, structural design, and intelligent manufacturing systems, supported by collaborations with universities and continuous patent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of wind power equipment and marine engineering products to wind turbine manufacturers and project developers. The company also earns income from wind farm electricity generation and related zero-carbon business activities, as well as from innovation and other ancillary services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in the wind turbine tower and marine engineering equipment sector, recognized for high product quality and technological innovation. It competes with other major wind equipment suppliers in China and internationally, maintaining strong relationships with top-tier wind turbine OEMs and holding a significant market share in both onshore and offshore wind equipment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 4.84 billion, a slight increase of 0.52% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 182 million, a decrease of 37.77%. The company has a total asset base of over RMB 9.4 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and technology upgrades, with a focus on steady growth in onshore wind equipment and strategic development in offshore and overseas markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, diversified product offerings including steel and hybrid concrete towers, large offshore foundations, and floating wind platforms, supported by advanced manufacturing processes and stringent quality control. Its strong brand reputation, extensive certifications, and close partnerships with leading global wind turbine manufacturers differentiate it in the competitive wind power equipment market. The company also leverages its integrated production bases to reduce logistics costs and enhance service responsiveness.
